children: Muthoot Fincorp is reportedly set to become the title sponsor of Indian cricket for the next two years, with the company expected to partner with the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) for international and domestic matches played in India.

According to media reports, the partnership is expected to commence with India’s upcoming ODI series against the West Indies later this month and run until March 31, 2028. The reported deal is being referred to as ‘Blue Muthoot’.
The sponsorship is understood to have been negotiated at a base price of Rs 4.85 crore per match, higher than the Rs 4.3 crore per match paid by outgoing title sponsor IDFC First Bank.
Neither the BCCI nor Muthoot Fincorp has formally announced or confirmed the reported agreement yet.

Reports suggest the BCCI had evaluated several potential sponsors, including Google Gemini, IDFC First Bank, Spinny and SBI Life, during the process. The reports also indicated that the board could have concluded the appointment earlier had the process involved competitive bidding.
The reported Muthoot Fincorp deal comes as the BCCI builds out its commercial roster for the 2026–28 home cricket cycle, with the board already having announced three associate partnerships.

On September 8, the BCCI reported Campa, SBI Life and ChatGPT as associate partners for India’s home cricket for two seasons. The partnerships are also scheduled to begin with the upcoming West Indies series and continue through March 2028.

The three associate partnerships have a combined value of more than Rs 130 crore, according to the BCCI, representing a 44 per cent increase over the previous cycle. The board attributed the growth to the continued commercial appeal of India’s home cricket season and the strength of the Indian cricket ecosystem.

BCCI President Mithun Manhas had earlier highlighted the increased value of the associate partnerships, noting that the brands bring different propositions to Indian cricket and that their participation reflects the reach and commercial potential of the BCCI’s home season.

With Muthoot Fincorp expected to take the title sponsorship position, the BCCI’s bilateral cricket sponsorship portfolio for the upcoming home cycle will comprise the title sponsor alongside associate partners Campa, SBI Life and ChatGPT.
